purpose: Bind all 14 registered Mem-Gallery methods to immutable sources, explicit adapters, one matched evidence budget, and complete call accounting before lifecycle or numerical execution.
scientific_question: Under one local answer model and one 1711-question surface, which memory mechanisms improve answer and evidence quality, and which occupy a useful quality-efficiency or quality-safety Pareto point?

source_bindings.adapter_boundary: Use a project overlay; do not edit the checkout. Replace source placeholders with frozen local endpoints, emit stable qids and call traces, and convert swallowed storage/retrieval/answer exceptions into explicit retained failures.

Caption each Mem-Gallery round using dataset-provided captions, call add_note in chronology order, call search_agentic with the frozen K, and preserve A-MEM note analysis, linking, and evolution calls.

Caption each round, preserve chronological user-assistant pairs and hierarchical updates, expose retrieve_context rather than MemoryOS answer generation, and leave final answering to the matched answer wrapper.

Preserve raw and semantic stores plus the memory-manager loop, route text and image embeddings to frozen local endpoints, cap returned evidence prospectively, and use a fresh database root for every method-seed run.

Preserve the four query-modality routes, caption folding, SigLIP2 visual lane, MiniLM text lane, generated anchors, round collapse, and neighbor windows; parameterize paths/model/endpoints and emit exact retrieved round ids.

matched_protocol.answer_memory_budget: Qwen tokenizer N_text + 256*N_images <= 4096, applied after method retrieval and before the shared answer call
matched_protocol.truncation_tie_break: Preserve method rank first, then chronological round id; full-memory controls retain newest content when the budget is exceeded.
matched_protocol.method_internal_llm: The same frozen Qwen answer model is used for method-required extraction, routing, mutation, reflection, and anchor generation, but every call is accounted separately from the final answer call.

failure_semantics.ingestion_failure: Reject the method-seed raw run because all subsequent questions may depend on corrupted memory state; retain the failed root and logs.
failure_semantics.question_failure: Emit one FAILED prediction row with nonempty error_type/error and retain it in the 1711-question denominator.
failure_semantics.process_exit_zero: Never sufficient: exact qid order, row count, failure count, configuration identity, and evidence hashes must also pass.
failure_semantics.retry: Any recovery uses a separately frozen fresh run root; no in-place overwrite or selective rerun after score observation.

authorization: This artifact freezes source mapping and budgets only. It does not authorize lifecycle execution, numerical execution, scoring, table admission, AgentEnhance execution, SOTA language, or model cleanup.
